card.name: Digits 8 or 9 after a decimal point
card.fires_on: The digit 8 or 9 right after a decimal point, mostly in a number below 1 such as 0.9 or .81. It appears in statistics, percentages and dose tables.

modes.label: Digit 9 after 0.
modes.description: The digit 9 directly after a leading 0. in a percentage, ratio or dose.
modes.example: withholding of intravenous pembrolizumab in 0.<<9>>% (26) of patients.

modes.label: Digit after bare decimal point
modes.description: A digit 8 or 9 after a decimal point written without a leading zero, in a range or interval.

card.plain: It marks the digit 8 or 9 just after a decimal point in numbers like 0.9% or .81.
